examples.title: Example 1: Implementing a Text Clock with Start/Stop Control
examples.description:
This example demonstrates the basic usage of the TextClock component, setting the clock display format using the format attribute.
Clicking "start TextClock" triggers the callback to invoke TextClockController and initiate the clock. Clicking "stop TextClock" pauses the clock via TextClockController.
The example demonstrates how to continuously update accumulateTime content during clock updates by invoking the TextClockController callback.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Text Shadow Style
examples.description: This example shows how to set the text shadow style for the text clock using the textShadow attribute.

examples.title: Example 3: Configuring the Custom Content Area
examples.description: This example implements the functionality of customizing the style of a text clock, creating a time picker component with a custom style: The time picker dynamically adjusts its selected value based on the text clock's timezone offset and the time zone offset in seconds from UTC, creating a clock effect; depending on whether the text clock is started, the time picker toggles between a 12-hour and a 24-hour format display.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting Leading Zero
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the dateTimeOptions attribute to add or remove the leading zero for the hour field. By default, the hour field includes a leading zero in the 24-hour format, but typically does not include a leading zero in the 12-hour format.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting the Text Display Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the fontFeature, fontColor, fontStyle, fontWeight and fontFamily attributes to set the text display style of the clock.
